description.zh: 阿里云百炼平台工作空间ID
description.en: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace ID

descriptions.zh:
请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解法睿产品的收费方式和价格。

- 该接口需要开通法睿商品相关的后付费服务（开通免费），可以使用该账号的AccessKey和AccessSecret来调用我们的OpenApi服务

- 服务的响应结果是以流式的形式来返回（SSE）。

- 接口的调用需要百炼平台的工作空间权限。
descriptions.en:
Before using this operation, review the FaRui product pricing and billing model.

- You must enable the pay-as-you-go service for FaRui. Enabling this service is free. Use your account’s AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret to call this OpenAPI operation.

- The operation returns responses in Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming format.

- You need Workspace Management permissions on the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio platform to call this operation.
